payload.title: Require a separate remote callback URI on Target whenever a broker is configured
payload.description: From the security review of #2 (finding 5). Owner: Papyrus session (target.py). Add Target.remote_callback_uri (HTTPS), required whenever broker_endpoint is set, so remote sign-in always checks the broker's redirect_uri and the approval_url's origin, including for targets whose callback_uri is a loopback URL. Then remote.py switches its two checks from callback_uri to remote_callback_uri (Cyclotron session).
